forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
During week 16 of April, teams completed 2 visits and 1 clearance. No zone surveys or technical surveys were completed. To date, 12 zones have been surveyed, 2 declared free, and 4 areas released.

Officer attention: 8 zones are closed according to the access feed. No teams were stood down or without a report for more than a week. No dossiers or reports were held, and no new plan was approved; the current plan is P04.

The forecast, made in week 14 for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is done already, is 9 to 14 mine areas cleared this season and 9 to 13 zones declared free this season.
